# 1 Enoch Chapter 100 — The SOPHIA Bible (Consensus)
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Source Manuscript:** Ge'ez MS; cf. 4QEn (Aramaic) | **Section:** Epistle of Enoch — Woe Oracles (final)

---

**100:1** And in those days, in one place, fathers together with their sons shall be struck down, and brothers shall fall in death one with another, until the streams flow with their blood.

**100:2** For a man shall not hold back his hand from slaying his sons and his sons' sons, and the sinner shall not hold back his hand from his honored brother; from dawn to sunset they shall slay one another.

**100:3** And the horse shall walk up to the breast in the blood of sinners, and the chariot shall be submerged to its height.

**100:4** And in those days the angels shall descend into the hidden places and gather together into one place all who helped bring sin down, and the Most High shall arise on that day of judgment to execute great judgment among sinners.

**100:5** And over all the righteous and holy He will appoint guardians from among the holy angels to guard them as the apple of an eye, until He makes an end of all wickedness and all sin; and though the righteous sleep a long sleep they need have no fear.

**100:6** And then the children of the earth shall see the wise in security, and shall understand all the words of this book, and recognize that their riches shall not be able to save them in the day when their sins are overthrown.

**100:7** Woe to you, sinners, on the day of strong anguish — you who afflict the righteous and burn them with fire; you shall be repaid according to your works.

**100:8** Woe to you, you stubborn of heart, who watch in order to devise wickedness; therefore dread shall come upon you, and there shall be none to help you.

**100:9** Woe to you, sinners, on account of the words of your mouths and on account of the deeds of your hands which your godlessness has wrought; in blazing flames burning worse than fire shall you burn.

**100:10** And now know that from the angels He will inquire about your deeds in heaven — from the sun and from the moon and from the stars — in reference to your sins, because upon the earth you exercise dominion over the righteous.

**100:11** And He will summon every cloud and mist and dew and rain to testify against you; for they shall all be withheld from you because of your sins, and you shall not receive the dew and the rain.

**100:12** Now then, give gifts to the rain that it may not be withheld from falling on you, nor the dew, if perhaps it will accept gold and silver from you and come down.

**100:13** When the frost and snow with their chilliness, and all the snowstorms with all their plagues, fall upon you, in those days you shall not be able to stand before them.

---

*SOPHIA notes: LOGOS register adopted. Ch. 100 concludes the woe oracle cycle. The apocalyptic bloodbath of vv. 1–3 (horse-deep in blood) is preserved exactly from EMET/LOGOS — this extremity is authentic and must not be softened. V. 5's "apple of an eye" is a deliberate echo of Deuteronomy 32:10 and should be retained. V. 12's ironic invitation to bribe the rain is preserved from LOGOS — PNEUMA captures the sarcasm well but expands beyond the Ge'ez. The creation-as-witness motif (sun, moon, stars, rain, frost) anticipates the formal argument of ch. 101. Divergences logged.*
